remarks: Welcome to 27 Northill, a bright and spacious 1 level, 2 bed/2 bath located in the heart of Stamford's desirable Springdale neighborhood. Inside, you'll find a newly renovated kitchen completed in 2022, which flows seamlessly into a sunny and generously sized living room with a separate dining area. Step out onto your private balcony to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day. Both bedrooms are equally spacious with brand new LVF flooring, and the primary suite includes a large walk-in closet and an en-suite bath. Refinished parquet floors add warmth and charm throughout. For an added bonus, heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included! Laundry facilities are located on every floor of the building, and the unit comes with one reserved parking space in the covered garage. With just a short walk to the Springdale train station, this location offers easy access to Metro-North for commuters. You'll also enjoy nearby shops, award-winning restaurants, schools, parks, and all the local amenities that make Springdale one of Stamford's most sought-after communities. This is not to be missed!
